items.title: LA calls timeout after Thunder get out on 6-0 run, capped by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander putting back a Josh Dix miss
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
LA calls timeout after Thunder get out on 6-0 run, capped by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander putting back a Josh Dix miss

Thunder only have one steal, but Aday Mara has 3 of the 4 Thunder blocks. Tyronn Lue probably telling his team to stop challenging Mara when he's right there

LA lead down to 35-33
